title: Measure and strengthen impact
summary: Define practical indicators, collect proportionate evidence, disclose limitations and learn from results.
detail: The intended approach separates activities, outputs, outcomes and long-term ambitions. Any method must fit the decision being made, protect participants and avoid turning an estimate or product signal into an environmental or social result.
problem: Broad impact language can hide weak definitions, missing baselines and evidence that cannot support the conclusion being claimed.
provides: Learning reviews and responsible reporting support
exclusions: Audit, certification or regulatory assurance unless separately qualified
Invented baselines, outcome totals or causal claims
Official SDG, 3ZERO, EPR or government endorsement
process: Define the decision and change pathway, specify evidence and owners, collect only appropriate data, then review findings and limitations together.
expectedOutputs: A documented theory of change or measurement question
Indicators with definitions, periods, scope, sources and owners
A learning record that distinguishes findings from uncertainty
modelNote: Proposed only. Suitable expertise, independence, scope and commercial terms must be agreed; this is not presented as an assurance service.
